name: Crimson Dragonscale already rests on the ground at Grim Batol (#8822)
contract: The report and a static read of nearby decorative models suggested the pickup (gameobject entry 254233, guid 6940273) was pushed 1.7-2 yd under a raised camp surface by rev_20261006_65. The gameplay harness's own ground probe (the same native Map::GetHeight the server uses) disagrees: at the current height (281.7468) the gap is 0.0003 yd, grounded; restoring the realm-recorded height (284.741) would instead float it 2.99 yd above that ground, since the camp's decorative props are not collidable terrain. The pickup already rests on the ground and opens; no SQL change.
